name: Alterac Granite
summary: Near Darrow Hill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, Alterac Granite draws master stonecutters with its resilience and grain. King Magni Bronzebeard’s royal mason insists on the stone for a tribute to fallen soldiers.

sections.title: Stone of Memorials
sections.body: King Magni Bronzebeard ordered a monument to Sully Balloo, a brave dwarven defender who died in the tragedy at the Thandol Span. Grand Mason Marblesten was charged with sculpting it in Ironforge. He insisted on Alterac Granite instead of ordinary quarry stone. Few stones in the Eastern Kingdoms are finer, and its durability keeps a fallen hero’s likeness and memory untarnished for generations.

sections.title: Quarried in Peril
sections.body: Alterac Granite lies around Darrow Hill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, near the ruined territories of Alterac. Hostile wildlife, syndicate brigands and lingering strife make the journey perilous. To bring unblemished slabs to Ironforge’s artisans, you must venture deep into contested lands.

faq.q: What is Alterac Granite used for?
faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten in Ironforge requested Alterac Granite for a royal memorial to Sully Balloo, the dwarven soldier who fell defending the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Where can Alterac Granite be found?
faq.answer: You can gather Alterac Granite from deposits at Darrow Hill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, near the border of Alterac.

faq.q: Why did Grand Mason Marblesten specifically want this stone?
faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten considers Alterac Granite one of the finest and most resilient carving stones available. He deems it worthy of the lasting royal monument King Magni commissioned.
Sully Balloo was a dwarven soldier who died during the fighting at the Thandol Span. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned a monument to honor his sacrifice for the Alliance.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know why dwarven stonemasons prize quality. This robust mountain stone honors a fellow son of Ironforge.
As a miner or prospector, you can appreciate Alterac Granite’s clean fracture and extraordinary density. These qualities set it apart from common crag rock.
